name: JMD Ventures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2000, JMD Ventures Limited is in the business of Media & Entertainment, and Equity Investment.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
JMD Ventures Ltd (JMDVL) operates in the entertainment and financial segments, engaging in music production, studio rentals, and capital market activities like financing and investing in shares, securities, and commodities. The company has produced over 10,000 songs in regional languages such as Bengali, Bhojpuri, and Rajasthani. It also has a presence in television and radio production through its dedicated divisions:
a) JMD TV
b) JMD Sounds
c) JMD Music
d) JMD Digital
The company also has a digital presence with channels like:
a) JMD-Rajasthani
b) JMD-Bhakti Sagar
c) JMD-Bangla
d) JMD Bhakti Geeti (Bangla)
e) JMD Purulia (Dhamaka)
Apart from this, the company has invested significantly in music studios, producing 
a wide range of music genres, including 
Popular Music, Classical Music, Soul Music, Dance Music, New-age Music, Experimental Music, Vocal Music, Electro Music, Devotional Music, Bhajans, Ghazals,

pros: Stock is trading at 0.34 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.39% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 370 days.
Working capital days have increased from 2,802 days to 4,350 days
